import json
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface

OUT = "/Users/yuluo/Desktop/game/games_test/reverse-engineering/tiny-glade/evidence/toolchain/clutter-extra/"
prog = currentProgram
ADDRS = {
  "0x1422d4870": "construct_inter_roof_merlons",
  "0x141ce3a70": "detect_inter_roof_merlons",
  "0x141cd1a90": "detect_intra_shape_corners",
  "0x141cd16b0": "wallandroofchanges_dirty_walls",
  "0x141cd3ce0": "add_hole_at_shape_intersection",
  "0x140edbf60": "intersect_shapes_closure4_stitches",
  "0x140edd250": "intersect_shapes_closure4_merlons",
  "0x141ce65b0": "spawn_stitches",
  "0x141ce7190": "spawn_stitch_bricks"
}
meta = {}
for s, label in ADDRS.items():
    monitor.checkCancelled()
    addr = prog.getAddressFactory().getAddress(s)
    fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
    f = fm.getFunctionAt(addr)
    rec = {"addr": s, "label": label}
    if f is None:
        rec["error"] = "absent"
        meta[s] = rec
        continue
    rec["name"] = str(f.getName())
    rec["body"] = str(f.getBody())
    rec["signature"] = str(f.getSignature())
    d = DecompInterface()
    try:
        d.openProgram(prog)
        res = d.decompileFunction(f, 60, monitor)
        if not res.decompileCompleted():
            rec["error"] = str(res.getErrorMessage())
        else:
            c = res.getDecompiledFunction().getC()
            open(OUT + label + ".c", "w").write(c)
            rec["c_len"] = len(c)
    finally:
        d.dispose()
    meta[s] = rec
open(OUT + "host_meta.json", "w").write(json.dumps(meta, indent=1))
print(json.dumps(meta))
